symbols.name: CacheDimensionsBuilder
symbols.summary: Declares typed dependency schemas through a collection's grouped dimension callback.
symbols.remarks: Declarations append in order and share validation with the individual collection helpers. Nullable CLR types select the underlying scalar kind; explicit null values still require the allowNull setting. Configuration can replace the complete list, and catalog finalization checks its sixteen-dimension bound.
